correctness.rationale: Two independent representation certificates show that at least two representations occur exactly in (ab+<a,b>) union ((a+cb)+<a,b>). For each residue bj mod a, minimization yields thresholds ab+bj for j<c and a+bj for j>=c; all three invariants follow rigorously. Coprimality and inequalities handle Pell specialization. Independent finite dynamic-programming checks passed 2,791 coprime triples, 1,707,616 N tests, and seven Pell triples, corroborating but not replacing proof.

value.rationale: The p=1 denumerant counts distinct triples even when the third denomination adds no ordinary representability; the exact one-Apéry split explains how this alters the one-Frobenius number, genus and Sylvester sum for every integer parameter in a natural complete infinite family. It also settles the consecutive Pell-type case adjacent to published nonconsecutive triples; the result is not just a sample computation or a restatement of the usual two-coin formula.
